sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and on an impressive run of five consecutive wins, travel away to face Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. This should be a straightforward fixture for the leaders: Alsager are bottom of the league with just 4 points from 10 matches and have won only once in their last six outings, losing their last four games consecutively.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town at home, looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, face a tough test at home against Eccleshall, who sit fifth but have lost their last match. Fourth-ranked Wolverhampton Casuals are at home to Wednesfield Community, who are in mid-table but have shown recent form with a win. Bilston Town, sixth in the league, travel to face Foley Meir in what should be relatively even contest between mid-table sides. The bottom half features several struggling clubs: Brereton Social host Widnes Town (bottom, pointless in recent matches), Cheadle Heath Nomads away to Telford Town (both near the relegation zone), Crewe travel to face mid-table Allscott Heath, Market Drayton Town (12th place) host New Mills, and Shawbury United face Barnton at home looking to recover from a poor run of five consecutive losses.
